player_prompt.intro:
I kɛnɛ ka Minesweeper kɛlɛ.
Kɛlɛ la tɛɛrɛ ye ka kɛlɛ kɔɔrɔw ye mines ka taa.
Kɛlɛ kɛlɛ ka tɛɛrɛ ye, i kɔɔrɔw ye ka row ni column kɔɔrɔw ye ka tɛɛrɛ ye ka format:
- `[row col]`: Tɛɛrɛ kɛlɛ kɔɔrɔw ye ka row ni column kɔɔrɔw ye.
Kɔɔrɔ:
- `[3 2]` ka tɛɛrɛ kɛlɛ kɔɔrɔw ye Row 3, Column 2.
- `[5 6]` ka tɛɛrɛ kɛlɛ kɔɔrɔw ye Row 5, Column 6.
Kɛlɛ kɛlɛ ka tɛɛrɛ ye ka kɔɔrɔw ye, i kɔɔrɔw ye ka tɛɛrɛ kɛlɛ kɔɔrɔw ye ka safe start.
Kɛlɛ kɔɔrɔw ye ka tɛɛrɛ ye ka board layout ye ka kɔɔrɔw ye.
Kɛlɛ kɔɔrɔw ye ka tɛɛrɛ ye ka dot ('.') ye, kɛlɛ kɔɔrɔw ye ka revealed numbers ye ka count ye ka adjacent mines.
Kɛlɛ kɔɔrɔw ye ka tɛɛrɛ ye ka already revealed cells.
Kɔɔrɔ, kɛlɛ kɔɔrɔw ye ka tɛɛrɛ ye ka current board layout:

board.current_board: B sẽn get b yell masã wã: {board}

invalid_move.wrong_format: I kɔɔrɔw ye ka tɛɛrɛ ye ka valid coordinates ka square brackets.
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Kɛlɛ kɔɔrɔw ye ka row ni column kɔɔrɔw ye ka out of bounds.

game_action.revealed: Yi daa yi cell la zuɣu ({row}, {col}).

outcome.win: Mpuɣuɣu! I kpaŋmi taaba nɛɛrɛ Minesweeper tɛɛbɔ.
outcome.turn_limit: Wakati soobu la paɣa. I ku wam yɛlɛm {percent}% koomda siga sɛma.
